A.prompt: Write 30-50 words about your last weekend. Say where you went, what you did and how you felt. Use and, but and because.
A.answerKey: Last weekend I visited my grandparents in their village. We ate lunch in the garden and played football. It was very hot, but we had fun. I was tired on Sunday because we came home late.
acceptedAnswers: Last Saturday I went to the beach with my family. The water was cold, but I swam with my brother. We ate sandwiches and drank juice. I was happy because the sun was out all day.
Last weekend I stayed in my town. On Friday I went to the market with my mother and we bought fruit. I wanted to play football, but it rained. I felt bored because I was at home on Saturday.

B.prompt: Write 30-50 words about a trip with your class or a day out. Say where you went, what you saw and what you liked or did not like. Use and, but and because.
B.answerKey: Last month my class went to the zoo by bus. We saw lions and elephants, but we did not see the bears because they were asleep. I liked the monkeys because they were funny. Then we went back to school.
acceptedAnswers: Last spring we visited an old castle with our teacher. We saw big rooms and old pictures, but we did not go up the tower. I liked the garden because it had many flowers.
In March my class went to a farm. We fed the goats and we saw a very big horse. I did not like the smell, but the farmer was kind. It was a good day because we learned a lot.

C.prompt: Write 30-50 words about a day with bad weather. Say what the weather was like, what you did and how you felt. Use and, but and because.
C.answerKey: Last Friday it was rainy and windy. I wanted to go to the park, but my mum said no. We stayed at home and played a board game. I was happy because my cousins came too.
acceptedAnswers: Two weeks ago it was very cold and it snowed. We did not go to school because the roads were closed. I made a snowman with my sister, but my hands were cold.
Last winter there was a big storm. The wind was very strong, so we stayed inside. My father cooked soup and we watched a film. I was a bit scared, but it was also fun.
